questions.stemHtml: A 6-year-old girl presents with a history of multiple craniofacial anomalies, including downward slanting eyes, and small jaw. The mother informs that the child had recurrent middle ear infections and has a history of hearing loss. Examination reveals a high-arched palate and respiratory difficulty due to upper airway obstruction. Imaging studies demonstrate hypoplasia of mandible with malocclusion and absence of the zygomatic arch. What is the most likely diagnosis based on the clinical features, radiological findings and the image given below?
